name: Support complaints policy example
answer:
Customers may file a service complaint through the support portal.
Customers receive a final complaint response within 2 business days.
The company issues an automatic $100 credit for every complaint.

sources.title: Support Complaints Policy
sources.content:
Customers may file a service complaint through the support portal.
Support reviews complaints and provides a response timeline after investigating the issue.
Complaint outcomes may include an apology, correction, refund, or other remedy based on the investigation.
